card.name: Link words after dose amounts
card.fires_on: Small linking or punctuation tokens (every, under, of, an opening parenthesis, a dash, a colon) that come right after a dose, time or temperature figure in dosing tables and schedules.

modes.label: Frequency or condition word
modes.description: A word such as every or under that follows a dose or time amount and introduces the interval or condition.

modes.label: Bracket or punctuation after a figure
modes.description: An opening bracket, parenthesis, dash or colon placed right after a number or duration in a dosing table.
modes.example: Greater than 12 weeks<< (>>>84 days) Restart ELREXF

modes.label: Schedule wording
modes.description: A word within a restart or step-up dosing schedule that follows a drug name.
modes.example: Restart ELREXFIO<< step>>-up dosing schedule at step-up dose

card.plain: It fires on the small connecting marks and words that follow a dose or time amount in dosing tables.
